19.name: Dreadful Reach: On Weapon Status Effect: +0.1 Range for 8 seconds. Stacks 20x
Raging Drift: +80% Attack Speed while sliding. +20% Slide

20.name: Nimble Scythe: For each enemy hit by Slide Attack, gain +5 Combo Count
Echoes of Rage: +1 Combo Count on Shard Damage

21.name: Swift Transmute: Reach 3x Combo and Heavy Attack to activate Incarnon Form
Vaulting Leap: +100% Jump and Double Jump Height
Devastating Mercy: Ground Finishers knock enemies down in 6m radius

22.name: Shards grow when a new shard is created, up to 3 times. Fully grown shards erupt out of the embedded enemy, dealing x2 damage and impaling them on the spot.
Chain Shatter: Heavy attacks detonate shards. Shards caught within the blast radius will also detonate
Void Splinters: Shard duration is increased to 30s. Shards become weak spots that have +100% Critical Chance when damaged. Shard damage is reduced by -50%

description: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.
name: Thalys
